quoted_text: Recently, I have elaborated on the mathematical formulation for a system of processes that are mutually connected to be isomorphic to a conscious percept of a point in space. Importantly, in such a system, any process can be derived through all other processes that form its complement, or “interpretation.” To generate such a solution, I am proposing a dynamical system of oscillators coupled in a manner to preserve the properties of a percept.
